mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY growth > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or PAYEMS drops > 100k do not correlate with subsequent market downturns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO drops > 1% MoM do not correlate with subsequent market downturns.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5% in 3 months, it signals a tightening cycle with labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent market downturns.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and real GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% YoY, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST drops > 10% YoY and GDPC1 growth < 2% YoY
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent market downturns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in tight labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) growth is above 3% YoY, it signals accommodative monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent market upturns.
